_doc: Hand-written meaning for each command form. commands.<route>.description is what the command Choice sees; keywords feed the retriever only. args.<route>.<arg>: choice args get question/stated/options (option keys are literal CLI tokens and override the parsed values); flags get question. Routes not listed fall back to the CLI summary; args not listed get a generic question.
